title: What is an online Tamil school?
content: An online Tamil school offers live, teacher-led Tamil language classes through a secure video platform. Students learn to speak, read, write, and understand Tamil from home, with lessons designed for children, teens, and adults.

title: Who can enroll in the Tamil classes?
content: Our classes welcome learners of all backgrounds. We offer age-appropriate groups for children and teens, as well as beginner-friendly options for adults. A parent or guardian should complete enrollment for students under 18.

title: Do students need to know Tamil before joining?
content: No. Beginner classes start with the Tamil alphabet (uyir ezhuthukkal and mei ezhuthukkal), basic sounds, everyday words, and simple conversations. Learners with prior knowledge can be placed in a higher-level class.

title: How is my child's Tamil level determined?
content: New students complete a short placement activity or attend a trial session. The teacher reviews speaking, reading, and writing skills, then recommends the most suitable level. Families may request a level review after the first few classes.

title: What are the class schedules?
content: Most classes meet once or twice each week for 45 to 60 minutes. Weekend and weekday options may be available depending on the term. The current timetable, including the time zone, is shared during registration.

title: What technology do we need for online classes?
content: Students need a reliable internet connection, a computer or tablet with a camera and microphone, and access to the school video platform. Headphones are recommended in shared spaces. Families will receive joining instructions before the first class.

title: Are classes live or pre-recorded?
content: Classes are primarily live so students can interact with the teacher, practise pronunciation, and ask questions. Teachers may also share recordings, worksheets, or revision videos when permitted by school policy.

title: What will students learn?
content: Lessons develop Tamil listening, speaking, reading, and writing skills. Depending on the level, students may learn letters, vocabulary, grammar, sentence building, stories, poems, conversation, Tamil culture, and age-appropriate literature.

title: Are learning materials included?
content: Digital worksheets and lesson resources are usually included with enrollment. Some levels may require a workbook or notebook; any additional materials and their costs will be communicated before the term begins.

title: How much do classes cost and how do I pay?
content: Tuition varies by course level, class frequency, and term length. Fees and payment deadlines are shown on the registration page. Payments are generally made online, and families should contact the school before the due date if they need assistance.

title: Can my child try a class before enrolling?
content: A trial class or introductory assessment may be offered when space is available. This helps the student experience the online classroom and helps the teacher recommend the right level. Contact the school to check current availability.

title: What happens if a student misses a class?
content: Please notify the teacher or school office as early as possible. Students can use the shared lesson materials to catch up, and teachers may suggest practice activities. Make-up classes are subject to the school's attendance policy and are not guaranteed.

title: Is homework assigned?
content: Yes. Homework is kept age-appropriate and may include letter practice, reading, vocabulary review, short writing tasks, or listening activities. Regular practice between classes helps students gain confidence and make steady progress.

title: How can parents track progress?
content: Teachers provide feedback through class participation, completed work, and periodic assessments. Parents may receive progress updates during the term and can contact the teacher or school office with questions about their child's learning.

title: How do I contact the online Tamil school?
content: Use the contact form or support email listed on the school's website. Include the student's name, age group, current Tamil experience, and your preferred class time so the team can help with enrollment or course placement.
